articles.title: Luxury Car Cow Heist Busted: Hubballi Police Nab Gang Using High-End Vehicles for Cattle Theft
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a major crackdown, Hubballi police have busted a cattle theft gang that used luxury cars to steal cows from city roads, raising serious concerns over organised theft operations.

body.html:
In a major crackdown, Hubballi police have busted a cattle theft gang that used luxury cars to steal cows from city roads, raising serious concerns over organised theft operations.

The arrests were made by the Bendigeri police station team, which nabbed three accused, including Mubarak, a native of Shivamogga, along with his two associates. The gang has been sent to jail.

According to police, the accused used high-end vehicles brought from different districts and pasted black stickers on them to avoid identification. They allegedly targeted cattle resting on roadsides in areas such as Old Hubballi and Hubballi settlement.

CCTV footage (28 April 2026) played a crucial role in cracking the case. Visuals showed the accused loading cattle into the luxury vehicles and fleeing the scene. Acting on these inputs, police launched a targeted operation and successfully tracked down and arrested the gang members.

Officials said the accused repeatedly used the same modus operandi, arriving in cars, picking up unattended cattle, and escaping quickly before raising suspicion.

The police have seized the vehicles used in the crime, and further investigation is underway to ascertain if more individuals are involved in the racket.

articles.title: Noida ‘Gate Rage’ Caught on Camera: Woman Allegedly Assaults Guard After Car Hits Divider
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A fresh incident of alleged misconduct with a security guard has surfaced from Noida’s Sector-53, where a woman driver was caught on camera allegedly abusing and assaulting a guard at Kanchanjunga Apartments.

body.html:
A fresh incident of alleged misconduct with a security guard has surfaced from Noida’s Sector-53, where a woman driver was caught on camera allegedly abusing and assaulting a guard at Kanchanjunga Apartments.

The incident took place around 4 pm on Sunday when the woman had reportedly come to visit a relative in the society. While exiting the premises, her car allegedly hit a divider near the gate, triggering an argument with the guard on duty.

Eyewitnesses said the situation escalated rapidly as the woman began using abusive language. When the guard objected, she allegedly stepped out of her vehicle and physically assaulted him. The incident was recorded by residents on their mobile phones, and the video has since gone viral on social media.

Police said they have taken cognisance of the viral footage. Station House Officer Subodh Kumar of Sector-24 police station confirmed that an investigation has been initiated, though no formal complaint has been filed by either party so far.

The incident comes just days after a similar case in the nearby Rajat Vihar area, where an elderly security guard was reportedly assaulted, raising concerns over the repeated mistreatment of security personnel in residential societies.

Residents and observers have called for stricter action and greater respect for security staff, who serve as the first line of safety in such communities.

#Noida #BreakingNews #ViralVideo #SecurityGuard #Assault

articles.title: Woman Marries 9 Men, Dupes Victims of Lakhs in Beed Marriage Scam
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of a fake marriage racket has come to light in Maharashtra’s Beed district, where a woman allegedly married nine men and duped them of lakhs of rupees before fleeing.

body.html:
A shocking case of a fake marriage racket has come to light in Maharashtra’s Beed district, where a woman allegedly married nine men and duped them of lakhs of rupees before fleeing.

The latest incident was reported from Umapur village, where the accused targeted a young man through a network of agents posing as marriage brokers. The gang allegedly lured him with false claims, including that the woman was unmarried, and arranged the marriage after taking a hefty sum.

According to police, the woman had previously married eight men across different districts using a similar modus operandi. Shortly after each marriage, she would abscond with cash and valuables.

The racket primarily targeted young men in rural areas who were facing difficulties in finding brides. Agents reportedly created fake documents and facilitated quick marriages, only for the bride to disappear within days citing various excuses.

Suspicion arose in the latest case after the woman’s behaviour appeared doubtful. Upon further inquiry, it was revealed that she had carried out multiple such fraudulent marriages in the past.

The victim approached the Superintendent of Police, following which a case was registered and an investigation was launched.

Police said efforts are underway to trace the accused woman and other members of the organised gang involved in the racket.

#Beed #Maharashtra #BreakingNews #MarriageScam #FraudAlert

articles.title: Negligence or Disaster Waiting to Happen? Bull Electrocuted in Gonda, Locals Slam Power Dept Inacti
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a disturbing incident highlighting alleged negligence, a stray bull died of electrocution near Malviya Nagar Gurudwara in Uttar Pradesh’s Gonda on Sunday morning at around 8:21 am.

body.html:
In a disturbing incident highlighting alleged negligence, a stray bull died of electrocution near Malviya Nagar Gurudwara in Uttar Pradesh’s Gonda on Sunday morning at around 8:21 am.

The incident occurred within the Gonda city police station area after a broken electric wire reportedly caused current to pass through a nearby pole. The entire incident was captured on the Gurudwara’s CCTV camera.

Footage shows several stray animals near a gate, when one bull attempted to pass beside a parked vehicle close to the electric pole. As it came in contact with the electrified area, it was instantly electrocuted and died on the spot.

Local residents immediately alerted the electricity department and managed to get the power supply Disconnected. Later, a JCB machine was called to remove the carcass, and the animal’s last rites were performed by locals.

Residents alleged that they had been raising complaints with the electricity department since January 19, 2026, regarding damaged wires and dilapidated electric poles in the area, but no action was taken.

Demanding accountability, locals have called for immediate removal of hazardous wires and poles, along with strict action against negligent officials.

A local resident, KB Singh, said, “A stray animal died due to electrocution this morning. Monkeys often damage wires here. We had complained earlier, but no one acted. The wire was hanging low, which led to this incident.”

Attempts to contact electricity department officials for a response were unsuccessful, as calls to their official numbers went unanswered.

#Gonda #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #Negligence #ElectricityDept

articles.title: Highway Drama in Maharajganj: Woman Blocks Traffic, Climbs Vehicles, Sparks Chaos at Busy Junction
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A commotion broke out at a busy crossroads in Uttar Pradesh’s Maharajganj district on Monday evening after a mentally unstable woman created a ruckus, blocking traffic on the Gorakhpur–Sonauli National Highway for nearly half an hour.

body.html:
A commotion broke out at a busy crossroads in Uttar Pradesh’s Maharajganj district on Monday evening after a mentally unstable woman created a ruckus, blocking traffic on the Gorakhpur–Sonauli National Highway for nearly half an hour.

The incident took place in the main town area under Kolhui police station limits. Eyewitnesses said the woman intermittently stood in front of buses and even climbed onto a Bolero vehicle, disrupting traffic and causing panic among commuters.

As the situation escalated, hundreds of onlookers gathered at the spot, with many recording videos of the incident. The woman was also heard accusing passersby of assaulting her.

Police reached the scene after receiving information and managed to bring the situation under control. The woman was counselled and taken to the police station.

According to initial police investigation, she is a resident of Purandarpur and is mentally unstable. The Station House Officer said efforts are being made to trace her family.

Traffic movement resumed soon after she was removed from the spot, and normalcy was restored in the area.

#Maharajganj #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #HighwayChaos #TrafficDisruption

articles.title: Youth Steals Bones from Funeral Pyre to Control Girlfriend, Tantrik Among 3 Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking case of superstition-driven crime, three men, including a self-styled tantrik, were arrested in Uttar Pradesh’s Hapur for allegedly tampering with a burning funeral pyre and collecting human remains as part of an occult ritual.

body.html:
In a shocking case of superstition-driven crime, three men, including a self-styled tantrik, were arrested in Uttar Pradesh’s Hapur for allegedly tampering with a burning funeral pyre and collecting human remains as part of an occult ritual.

The incident occurred in the Kotwali Dehat area and came to light after the cremation of 16-year-old Shubhanshu, an intermediate student who died following a prolonged illness. After the grieving family performed the last rites and left the cremation ground, the accused allegedly arrived on a motorcycle and removed bones from the pyre.

Eyewitnesses raised an alarm on noticing the act, but the trio managed to flee. Police were alerted and, based on CCTV footage, identified and arrested the accused on Tuesday. The arrested individuals include Aman, his associate, and the tantrik identified as Awadhesh Sharma.

During interrogation, Aman told police that he wanted to “control” his girlfriend and her family. He claimed the tantrik had instructed him to bring human remains from a burning pyre for a ‘vashikaran’ ritual, assuring him that it would make them submissive.

Police said that while initial claims suggested a skull was stolen, investigation revealed that the body had already been cremated and only some bones were taken.

During raids, police recovered a large quantity of suspicious occult-related material from the accused. Over 50 photographs of different men and women were also seized. Officials are now trying to identify these individuals and ascertain whether they were victims of similar practices or had approached the tantrik.

Station House Officer Neeraj Kumar said the probe is ongoing from multiple angles, including possible links to a wider occult network.

#Hapur #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #OccultCrime #Superstition

articles.title: Daughter Exposes Husband: CCTV Reveals Truth Behind Mother’s Death, Arrest Made
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 19-year-old woman played a key role in exposing her husband, leading to his arrest for allegedly causing her mother’s death and misleading the family. Based on a complaint filed by K Kavya, Medipally police arrested her husband, K Snehit (28), on May 1 on charges of culpable homicide.

body.html:
A 19-year-old woman played a key role in exposing her husband, leading to his arrest for allegedly causing her mother’s death and misleading the family.

Based on a complaint filed by K Kavya, Medipally police arrested her husband, K Snehit (28), on May 1 on charges of culpable homicide.

According to police, the incident involved Kavya’s mother, K Aruna (39), who sustained fatal head injuries after falling from a motorcycle.

Medipally Inspector Ch Shankaraiah said Snehit, who works at an NGO, had married Kavya last year but was reportedly unhappy with the marriage. He had earlier complained to Aruna about issues with Kavya.

On April 29, Snehit visited Aruna’s house and offered to take her out to buy food. He insisted that she accompany him on his bike.

During the ride, the two allegedly got into an argument over family matters. Police said Snehit, who had kept a helmet on the fuel tank, picked it up and struck Aruna on the head. She lost balance, fell from the bike, and suffered serious head injuries.

After the incident, Snehit reportedly told Kavya that her mother had suffered an epileptic seizure and fallen accidentally. Aruna later died on April 30 while undergoing treatment at a private hospital.

However, Kavya grew suspicious and checked CCTV footage from a nearby house, which allegedly showed Snehit hitting Aruna while riding the bike.

Following this, she approached the police, leading to his arrest.

Police stated that preliminary investigation suggests Snehit did not intend to kill Aruna but acted in anger during the argument. Further investigation is underway.

#Telangana #Medipally #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #CCTV

articles.title: 2 Hours in 41°C Heat: Tribal Minor’s Body Left on Road in MP, Family Forced to Carry Corpse
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident from Madhya Pradesh’s Ashoknagar district, the death of a 15-year-old tribal girl has raised serious questions over administrative apathy and denial of dignity even after death.

body.html:
In a shocking incident from Madhya Pradesh’s Ashoknagar district, the death of a 15-year-old tribal girl has raised serious questions over administrative apathy and denial of dignity even after death.

The incident occurred in Bahadurpur town of Mungawali block, where the minor girl’s body allegedly lay on the roadside for nearly two hours under a scorching 41°C sun after her post-mortem was completed.

The girl, a resident of Kheroda Chakk village, was found girl inside her home the previous evening under suspicious circumstances. Her family brought the body to the Bahadurpur Primary Health Centre the same night. However, they alleged that no assistance was provided, forcing them to guard the body overnight from stray animals.

By around 10 am the next day, the post-mortem was completed. But the situation worsened as the hospital allegedly failed to provide even basic facilities—no stretcher, no cloth or plastic sheet to wrap the body, and no ward boy to assist.

Left with no option, the grieving family carried the body themselves under the blazing sun. With no hearse or official vehicle available, they placed the body by the roadside and pleaded with passing drivers for help. Despite offering money, no one agreed.

For nearly two hours, the minor’s body remained on the roadside, highlighting a complete breakdown of basic services. The situation was resolved only after social worker Aditya Trivedi reached the spot and transported the body to the village in his private vehicle.

The incident has triggered widespread outrage, with locals questioning the lack of dignity and support provided to a poor tribal family in such a sensitive case.

Bahadurpur Medical Officer Dr Y.S. Tomar, when questioned, said that post-mortem arrangements typically involve the police and that delays in vehicle availability are common. He added that while facilities exist at district hospitals, timely support is often lacking.

The case has also raised concerns over whether proper legal protocols were followed, as the deceased was a minor and the death was under suspicious circumstances. Reports suggest that mandatory procedures, including the presence of an executive magistrate, may not have been fully observed.

Police and health authorities are now under scrutiny, as questions mount over accountability and systemic failure in handling such cases.

#Ashoknagar #MadhyaPradesh #BreakingNews #TribalRights #SystemFailure

articles.title: ‘Yeh Wahi Dulha Nahi!’ Bride Walks Off Stage in Shahdol, Baraat Returns Empty-Handed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a dramatic incident from Madhya Pradesh’s Shahdol district, a bride refused to marry during the varmala ceremony, forcing the wedding procession to return without the bride.

body.html:
In a dramatic incident from Madhya Pradesh’s Shahdol district, a bride refused to marry during the varmala ceremony, forcing the wedding procession to return without the bride.

The incident took place in the Byohari police station area, where the baraat had arrived from Gohparu on Wednesday. The groom’s side was welcomed, and traditional Dwarchar rituals were completed. The groom reached the stage for the varmala ceremony, followed by the bride.

However, moments before exchanging garlands, the bride looked at the groom for a while and suddenly stepped off the stage, leaving everyone stunned.

When questioned by her family, the bride stated that the man present was not the same person with whom her marriage had been arranged. Despite repeated attempts by relatives and the groom’s side to persuade her, she remained firm in her decision.

Police were called to the venue and tried to counsel both parties. Later, both sides were taken to the police station, where a written agreement was reached to call off the marriage by mutual consent.

The groom’s family reportedly expressed shock, stating they had not even made any dowry demands and questioned why the issue was not raised earlier.

Following the incident, the baraat returned without the bride. The episode has created a sensation in the area, with videos of the incident going viral on social media.

#Shahdol #MadhyaPradesh #WeddingDrama #BreakingNews #ViralVideo

articles.title: Noida PG Horror: Youth Thrashed by Friends with Gas Pipe After Refusing Stay,
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of violence has come to light from Noida, where a young man was allegedly brutally assaulted by his three friends after he refused to let them stay at his PG accommodation. According to police, the incident occurred in the Phase-3 police station area.

body.html:
A shocking case of violence has come to light from Noida, where a young man was allegedly brutally assaulted by his three friends after he refused to let them stay at his PG accommodation.

According to police, the incident occurred in the Phase-3 police station area. The accused attacked the victim with sticks and a gas pipe, leaving him severely injured.

Disturbing details suggest the assault continued for several minutes, during which the victim was beaten mercilessly. Reports also indicate that one of the accused filmed the incident while the others carried out the attack. The victim was allegedly threatened before the accused fled the spot.

Following the complaint, police registered a case and arrested one accuse, identified as Krishna. Efforts are currently underway to trace and arrest the remaining two accused.

ADCP RK Gautam confirmed that legal proceedings have been initiated based on the victim’s statement.

The incident has sparked outrage, raising concerns over rising violence among youth and safety in PG accommodations.

#Noida #UPCrime #BreakingNews #ViralVideo #CrimeNews
